literature_notes: All seven ledger lines (L1–L7) describe C-terminal fluorescent-protein fusions (EGFP, GFP, TagRFPT, mScarlet) to CDH5/VE-cadherin. CDH5 is a type-I single-pass transmembrane cadherin: extracellular domain residues 26–597, TM helix 598–618, intracellular tail 619–784. The C-terminus (residue 784) is therefore cytoplasmic; every cited tag is on the intracellular face and does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag site. No ledger line reports an N-terminal tag placed after the signal-peptide cleavage site (residue 25/26 junction), nor any insertion in an extracellular loop or inter-domain linker. The papers confirm that the tagged full-length protein traffics correctly to endothelial junctions (the extracellular domain is functional and surface-displayed), but the fluorescent moiety itself is intracellular. Because no ledger line grounds an extracellular tag position, zero sites are reported.

literature_other_positions.note: EGFP (and by L3–L7, GFP/TagRFPT/mScarlet) fused after the C-terminal residue Y784; the C-terminus lies in the intracellular tail (residues 619–784), so the tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular space.
